svg.aria-label: AntCloud drawn as a bench instrument: a cloud PC in a small server rack streams over a fibre to a switch, which feeds a Mac display and an iPhone on a dock. Both screens show the streamed desktop at 1920×1200, 60 fps, 20 Mbps with 39 ms latency.
svg.text: AntCloud · cloud PC to Mac and iPhone
Stream: cloud PC → switch → every screen
